entries.reason: Not a drop-in: 10.0.1 arrives via Dna.Framework -> Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.Json 2.0.0, compiled against Newtonsoft 10.0.0.0. Add-ins load inside sldworks.exe where the add-in's binding redirects are ignored and SolidDna's AssemblyResolve matches exact versions, so forcing 13.x breaks JSON config loading in SolidWorks. Fix needs a version-tolerant resolver in SolidDna plus a new SolidDna release; Windows/SolidWorks only (ai-mecca Plans/45 task 14)

4.3.3 comes from the published AngelSix.SolidDna 1.0.1.8 the templates/ScriptRunner reference; SolidDna itself already pins 4.3.4. Moving them means a SolidDna package bump (API drift) and on net472 a System.Net.Http package swap needs binding redirects SolidWorks ignores; cannot be built or tested off Windows (ai-mecca Plans/45 task 14)
